gaps.sentence: The whole project hinges ___ council approval.
The novel was translated ___ twelve languages.
gaps.explanation: translate FROM one language INTO another.

gaps.sentence: The dispute was referred ___ arbitration at the request of both unions.
gaps.explanation: 'Refer something to arbitration' = send it to an independent body to be settled.

gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.

gaps.sentence: Police suspect him ___ faking the documents.
It never occurred ___ me to check the address.
gaps.explanation: it occurred TO somebody = they thought of it.

gaps.sentence: Three workers were involved ___ the accident.
